topic: RoboHarness V2 workspace as robot harness
character: XiaoM: red cap with white spots, cream stem, black dot eyes; active participant.

operations: Resize within 1280x720, centered white extent to exact 16:9
Flatten alpha on white; normalize near-white colors with 3% fuzz, preserving cream stems
Strip metadata; no dithering; 32-color PNG palette; PNG compression level 9, filter 5
postprocessing.command_template: magick ORIGINAL -resize 1280x720 -background white -gravity center -extent 1280x720 -alpha remove -fuzz 3% -fill white -opaque white -strip +dither -colors 32 -define png:compression-level=9 -define png:compression-filter=5 PNG8:OUTPUT

tools.py and the short gripper.move snippet are illustrative labels/pseudocode, not an exact RoboHarness API listing.
Tool-file repair and observation feedback do not imply model-weight training.
Physical safety gate and rollout review are an editorial deployment-safety boundary, not a claim that RoboHarness V2 implements or certifies a hardware safety gate.
No numerical performance or safety guarantee is asserted.
